'''Snow squadron''' was a [[A/SF-01 B-wing starfighter/Legends|B-wing starfighter]] [[Squadron/Legends|squadron]] of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] active during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].<ref name="SWG:SootaRBWs" />
{{Reb-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
Snow squadron appeared in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:SootaRBWs" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> Snow squadron was added to the game with the release of the expansion pack [[Star Wars Galaxies: Jump to Lightspeed|''Jump to Lightspeed'']] on [[October 27]], [[2004]].<ref name="SWG:SootaRBWs" />

==Appearances==
